chose: A week asks five questions, one from each family, each family's variants rotated least recently asked first (targets: about yourself 90 s, a time you… 120 s, why this role 60 s, strengths and weaknesses 90 s, a decision 120 s), with four while the calls record holds no call, and carries three cards, one each from an epic with a Why, a doc under docs/ and a declared invariant, topped up from any kind when one has none. Each card gets its own situation from a closed list of four, rotated the same way. A card's target is its script's words at 150 a minute, held to 150 to 300 words and at most 30 words a line.
options: (a) one question per family and one card per kind, every week
(b) a varying subset of families each week
gray: #2935 sets 4 to 6 questions and a mix of epics, docs and invariants, and leaves how many of each, the targets and the situations open; each decides what the owner practises every week.
undo: Change FAMILIES or TARGET_SECONDS in packages/ui/interview-week/src/lib/week/index.ts, CARDS, SITUATIONS, SCRIPT_WORDS or READ_WORDS_PER_MINUTE in src/lib/monday/bundle.ts, or WORDS in src/lib/monday/finish.ts.
